<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 224.120 Da, which corresponds to a protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 223.113 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass, within typical MS tolerance, is C₁₂H₁₅O₄. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C12H15O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H15O4</final_answer>
